title: Kristen's Instant Soups
body:
Kristen's Instant Soups is a data pack based off of old pvp plugins which allowed the usage of instant use soups which heal health. This datapack currently allows Mushroom Stew, Rabbit Stew, and Beetroot Soup to be instantly consumed! When consumed the soups will heal 3.5 hearts. Rabbit Stew heals 7 hearts. This datapack also adds two brand new types of soups being Cactus Juice and Chocolate Milk both of which act the same as Mushroom Stew. 

_Please note this datapack currently only works with crafted soups!_
